Re-issued; rejected in round 1. The check now reads the unit of the InvestmentOwnedBalancePrincipalAmount fact on context C_9a49e5b7 (iso4217:USD). I confirmed the 10-K instance defines only one currency unit, U_USD (iso4217:USD appears twice; there is no EUR unit). The check also requires principal to move more than twice as much as cost (4.1 pct against 0.7 pct), the pattern of a translated euro par. The planted EUR unit makes the reader return iso4217:EUR, so the check fails. Sandbox and production OK. Residual: this filer has no non-USD unit at all, and the EUR forward legs are printed but not tagged in EUR, so the unit shows the filer reports in USD rather than proving a conversion. The co-movement test is what ties the figure to a USD translation. This meets the D-252 bar.
